interface.name: ukui_shell

description.summary: create ukui shell windows and helpers

interface.description: This interface is used by kylin powered Wayland shells to communicate with the compositor and can only be bound one time.

request.name: create_surface

description.summary: create a shell surface from a surface

request.description:
Create a shell surface for an existing surface.
Only one shell surface can be associated with a given surface.

request.name: get_current_output
request.description:
Request get the output under cursor.
Send current_output and done event after this request.

event.name: current_output

description.summary: send the output name under cursor

event.description: Emitted after bind ukui_shell or recieve get_current_output request.

arg.name: seat_name
arg.summary: seat name of cursor under output

event.name: done

description.summary: sent all output and seat info completely

event.description: This event is sent after all information has been sent after binding to the ukui shell object.

interface.name: ukui_surface
interface.description:
An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for implementations that provide the shell user interface.
It provides requests to set surface roles, assign an output or set the position in output coordinates.
On the server side the object is automatically destroyed when the related wl_surface is destroyed. On client side, ukui_surface.destroy() must be called before destroying the wl_surface object.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The ukui_surface interface is removed from the wl_surface object that was turned into a shell surface with the ukui_shell.get_surface request. The shell surface role is lost and wl_surface is unmapped.

request.name: set_output

description.summary: assign an output to this shell surface

request.description: Assign an output to this shell surface. The compositor will use this information to set the position when ukui_surface.set_position request is called.

request.name: set_position
request.description:
Move the surface to new coordinates.
Coordinates are global, for example 50,50 for a 1920,0+1920x1080 output is 1970,50 in global coordinates space.

request.name: set_skip_taskbar

description.summary: make the window skip the taskbar

request.description: Setting this bit to the window, will make it say it prefers to not be listed in the taskbar. Taskbar implementations may or may not follow this hint.

arg.name: skip
arg.summary: Boolean value that sets whether to skip the taskbar

request.name: set_skip_switcher

description.summary: make the window not appear in a switcher

request.description: Setting this bit will indicate that the window prefers not to be listed in a switcher.

arg.name: skip
arg.summary: Boolean value that sets whether to skip the window switcher.

request.name: set_property
request.description:
Set window property.
Values for property argument are described by ukui_shell.property and can be used together in a bitfield. The flags bitfield describes which property are supposed to be set.

request.name: set_role

description.summary: assign a role to this surface

request.description:
Assign a role to a shell surface.
The compositor handles surfaces depending on their role. See the explanation below.
This request fails if the surface already has a role, this means the surface role may be assigned only once.

request.name: set_panel_auto_hide
request.description: Setting this bit will indicate that the panel area not to be calculate in output usable area.

arg.name: hide
arg.summary: Boolean value that sets whether to hide the panel

request.name: open_under_cursor
request.description: Request the initial position of this surface to be under the current cursor position. Has to be called before attaching any buffer to this surface.

request.name: set_panel_takes_focus
request.description: By default various ukui_surface roles do not take focus and cannot be activated. With this request the compositor can be instructed to pass focus also to this ukui_surface.

arg.name: takes_focus
arg.summary: Boolean value that sets whether the panel takes focus

request.name: grab_keyboard

description.summary: make the surface take keyboard grab

request.description: This request makes the created surface take an explicit keyboard grab. This keyboard grab will be dismissed when the client destroys the surface. Grab all keyboard when seat is set to null.

arg.name: seat
arg.summary: the seat for which the keyboard should be grabbed

request.name: set_icon
request.description: Setting server decoration icon by icon name. Set icon name to null will use app_id to find icon.

event.name: position

description.summary: informs of a new position for the window

event.description: This event informs the client that the position of the window is about to change.

arg.name: x
arg.summary: the horizontal position of the window

arg.name: y
arg.summary: the vertical position of the window
